source: GuitarSet v1.1.0, Xi et al. (2018), https://zenodo.org/records/3371780
status: rejected as a solution to the focused false positive
hypothesis: A richer harmonic envelope dictionary can explain upper partials without inventing a D note. Compare geometric profiles 0.7^(h-1), 0.9^(h-1), and a per-note nonnegative mixture of those plus 1/h. All use the existing -40..40 cent tuning search.
conclusion: At 418 ms the mixture reduces error from 0.411 to 0.395 but retains D5 at 68.2 versus baseline 77.1. Pure geometric profiles reduce D5 further while increasing reconstruction error and shifting valid-note estimates. No corpus accuracy claim; candidate reverted.
